name: File Forge: Convert & Extract
short_description: Utility application to convert and extract files with ease directly on your Android device.
description: File Forge is your ultimate mobile file conversion and extraction companion. It supports converting files between popular formats, viewing and editing EXIF metadata, generating QR and barcodes, extracting text using advanced OCR, and optimizing your documents locally.
features: Universal image, video, and audio conversion
Quick QR code scanner and generator

name: BillBuddy – Bill Tracker
short_description: Smart bill reminder and payment tracker to help you stay organized and avoid late fees.
description: BillBuddy is a comprehensive personal finance organizer that tracks recurring payments, credit card bills, rent, loans, and subscriptions. Featuring automated reminders, calendar sync, spending category graphs, and local backups, it helps you manage your expenses seamlessly.
features: Unified tracking of EMIs, bills, and subscriptions
Visual calendar interface for due dates

name: Zip Connect - Node Puzzle
short_description: A beautifully crafted puzzle game. Connect nodes, clear paths, and challenge your logic.
description: Zip Connect brings a classic grid puzzle experience to your Android device. Guide nodes through path matching, clear multiple difficulty levels, and practice logical deduction in an offline-first premium puzzle environment.
features: Minimalist visual design with smooth transitions
Quick level reset and help options

name: Aarti Sangrah
short_description: A local, spiritual prayer list and Aarti collection app.
description: Aarti Sangrah is a lightweight collection of traditional prayers and devotional lyrics. It organizes devotions by event, category, and daily routine, enabling quick access offline.
features: Adjustable font sizing and reading modes

name: KB Snap
short_description: Compress photos and images to any target KB size for online forms and applications.
description: KB Snap is a fast, offline-first image compression and resizing utility for Android. Easily compress photos to specific target KB sizes, scale or crop images, and prepare files for forms and portal uploads with complete client-side privacy.
features: Compress photos to specific target KB sizes
Batch photo resizing and image scaling
Aspect ratio cropping for signature and passport photos
No server uploads, ads, or tracking

name: Ghost Trap: Reveal the World
short_description: A tactical arcade puzzle game where players claim territory, avoid ghosts, and reveal famous landmarks from around the world.
description: Ghost Trap is a territory-claiming arcade puzzle game featuring offline play, cloud save, power-ups, and optional purchases. Steer your avatar to fence off sections of the board, avoid wandering ghosts, and reveal famous global landmarks.
